notes: The doc self-declares Dress-Up, Social Roleplay and Life Simulation, and the loop is style-an-outfit-then-walk-the-runway, so Roleplay & Avatar Sim leads on the Dress Up preset: stage-runway is the shape because the dress phase, the walk and the voting crowd are precisely a catwalk fed by preparation space with the audience around it. The lobby, timed rounds, map voting and star scoring are Party & Casual's territory, so it is named as secondary and contributes tracker-leaderboard for the fashion levels and magazine-cover wall; I did not take space-staged, since players watch each other's 20-second walks rather than being sealed out of the stage, so social-hub carries the lobby instead. Both modifiers come from the author's own answers rather than from my reading: apartments are enterable and decorated, which is P3, and they are explicitly separate instanced spaces while each of the ten themed maps is its own environment, which is P4 — worth flagging upstream since P4 and P3 are not shipping yet, and the answers also scope the first build to Luxury Mall with one reused runway layout. Two things I decided without a user: teleporter-link as the marked entry from the venue into the instanced apartments, which would otherwise be unreachable, and the top-three podium, which no loaded option covers so it sits on the runway stage as part of the results area rather than as its own pick.
